items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: He was never what you'd call a hot get-off man, but he was a beautiful-sounding trumpet player. He sounded like Joe Smith to me.

ctx.x: Howard Scott. He was never what you'd call a hot get-off man, but he was a beautiful-sounding trumpet player. He sounded like Joe Smith to me. Beautiful tone. Well, years go by and it's nice to think back to some of them fellows, you know. Have their names come back up in my mind -- with the help of you.
Cootie could really play, too, you said, when...
